text.description_html:
LCN 4822 Pneumatic Door Closer / Opener

LCN 4822 (AUTO EQUALIZER) is LCN’s Pneumatic powered (Air Powered) MULTI-DOOR solution. It provides easy access for people with disabilities, the elderly, or the frail. Designed primarily for manual opening applications that occasionally require automatic opening via pneumatic motor.

The LCN 4822 is UL and cUL228 and meets the provisions of ANSI Standards A117.1, A156.19, and the Americans with Disabilities Act. (ADA). Quiet, Efficient & Reliable.

*Note: Requires Control Boxes with integral compressor or control box using auxiliary air supply.

The LCN 4822 plate mounted closer is shipped with regular arm, metal cover, and wood and machine screw pack.

Specifications and Features: of LCN 4822 Pneumatic Door Closer / Opener

  • Maximum Door Weight: 250 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 24" - 54" Interior / 24" - 42" Exterior
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Spring Size: Adjustable 2-5
  • Standard with Cover
  • Multi-Door Solution
  • Utilizes a 10,000,000 Cycle Heavy Duty Door Closer
  • No Guard Rails or Safety Mats Required
  • ADA Compliant
  • 2 Year Warranty
  • Aluminum Finish
  • LCN 4822 Specifications (PDF).
  • LCN 4822 Installation Instructions (PDF).

*Note: Requires Control Boxes with integral compressor or control box using auxiliary air supply. Not Included with Closer.
